[EN] Shamans No More
[ES] Se acabaron los chamanes
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Put the {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans} out of their probable misery.
[ES] Pon fin al probable sufrimiento de los {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I don't even want to think about why the argons created {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans}.
[ES] Ni siquiera quiero pensar en por qué los argones crearon a los {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans} guarding the rooms in the {@Rgn:46002$$Raga Evala} part of {@Rgn:46001$$the Three Towers}.
[ES] Mata a los {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans} que custodian las salas en la zona de {@Rgn:46002$$Raga Evala} de {@Rgn:46001$$the Three Towers}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "At least they aren't argons anymore."
[ES] "Al menos ya no son argones."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to the {@Rgn:46020$$Shineroot Chamber} and report to {@creature:246#1024$$Platanok}.
[ES] Regresa a la {@Rgn:46020$$Shineroot Chamber} e infórmale a {@creature:246#1024$$Platanok}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
